items.meaning: Take your time, no need to rush.

items.sentence: 考試仲有半個鐘，唔使急咁做。
items.jyutping: haau2 si3 zung6 jau5 bun3 go3 zung1, m4 sai2 gap1 gam2 zou6.
items.meaning: There’s still half an hour left for the exam, no need to rush to do it.

items.sentence: 我哋未決定，唔使急答我。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mei6 kyut3 ding6, m4 sai2 gap1 daap3 ngo5.
items.meaning: We haven’t decided yet, no need to rush to answer me.

items.sentence: 今次旅行唔使急，可以慢慢享受。
items.jyutping: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 m4 sai2 gap1, ho2 ji5 maan6 maan6 hoeng2 sau6.
items.meaning: This trip has no rush, you can enjoy it slowly.

items.sentence: 唔係你嘅錯，呢件事係因為系統出咗問題。
items.jyutping: m4 hai6 nei5 ge3 co3, ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 jan1 wai6 hai6 tung2 ceot1 zo2 man6 tai4.
items.meaning: It's not your fault, this matter is because the system had a problem.

items.sentence: 唔係你嘅錯，老細講錯咗指示。
items.jyutping: m4 hai6 nei5 ge3 co3, lou5 sai3 gong2 co3 zo2 zi2 si6.
items.meaning: It's not your fault, the boss gave the wrong instructions.

items.sentence: 我知道你難過，但唔係你嘅錯。
items.jyutping: ngo5 zi1 dou3 nei5 naan4 gwo3, daan6 m4 hai6 nei5 ge3 co3.
items.meaning: I know you are upset, but it's not your fault.

items.sentence: 唔係你嘅錯，我哋一齊面對呢個問題。
items.jyutping: m4 hai6 nei5 ge3 co3, ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 min6 deoi3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
items.meaning: It's not your fault; we will face this problem together.

items.sentence: 我只係覺得佢做嘢咪太急咗啲。
items.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 gok3 dak1 keoi5 zou6 je5 mai6 taai3 gap1 zo2 di1.
items.meaning: I just feel that he is doing things a bit too quickly.

items.sentence: 我只係覺得呢個計劃未必係最好嘅選擇。
items.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 mei6 bat1 hai6 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 syun2 zaak6.
items.meaning: I just feel that this plan might not be the best choice.

items.sentence: 我只係覺得我哋可以試下另一個方法。
items.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 gok3 dak1 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 si3 haa5 ling6 jat1 go3 fong1 faat3.
items.meaning: I just feel that we could try another method.

items.sentence: 我只係覺得佢講嘅唔係咁啱。
items.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 hai6 gok3 dak1 keoi5 gong2 ge3 m4 hai6 gam2 aam1.
items.meaning: I just feel that what he said is not quite right.

items.sentence: 如果係我，我就唔會咁做。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 hai6 ngo5, ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 gam2 zou6.
items.meaning: If it were me, I would not do that.

items.sentence: 你想咁做，不過如果係我，我會考慮清楚啲。
items.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 gam2 zou6, bat1 gwo2 jyu4 gwo2 hai6 ngo5, ngo5 wui5 haau2 leoi6 cing1 co2 di1.
items.meaning: You want to do that, but if it were me, I would think it over more carefully.

items.sentence: 如果係我，我會同佢講清楚啲。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 hai6 ngo5, ngo5 wui5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 cing1 co2 di1.
items.meaning: If it were me, I would explain things more clearly to him/her.

items.sentence: 你咁做好唔好？如果係我，我會先諗諗後果。
items.jyutping: nei5 gam2 zou6 hou2 m4 hou2? jyu4 gwo2 hai6 ngo5, ngo5 wui5 sin1 nam2 nam2 hau6 gwo2.
items.meaning: Is doing this a good idea? If it were me, I would consider the consequences first.

items.sentence: 上次講，你會點做？
items.jyutping: soeng6 ci3 gong2, nei5 wui5 dim2 zou6?
items.meaning: As mentioned last time, how would you do it?

items.sentence: 上次講，我哋要早啲開始。
items.jyutping: soeng6 ci3 gong2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zou2 di1 hoi1 ci2.
items.meaning: As mentioned last time, we need to start earlier.

items.sentence: 上次講，你哋住邊度？
items.jyutping: soeng6 ci3 gong2, nei5 dei6 zyu6 bin1 dou6?
items.meaning: As mentioned last time, where do you guys live?

items.sentence: 上次講，我最鍾意呢個方法。
items.jyutping: soeng6 ci3 gong2, ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ni1 go3 fong1 faat3.
items.meaning: As mentioned last time, this is my favourite method.

items.sentence: 你係咪今晚返屋企？
items.jyutping: nei5 hai6 mai6 gam1 maan5 faan1 uk1 kei2?
items.meaning: Are you going home tonight?

items.sentence: 佢話佢今日唔嚟，係咪？
items.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 loi4, hai6 mai6?
items.meaning: He said he’s not coming today, isn’t he?

items.sentence: 我哋係咪應該提前準備？
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai6 mai6 jing1 goi1 tai4 cin4 zeon2 bei6?
items.meaning: Should we prepare in advance?

items.sentence: 你真係去咗日本，係咪？
items.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 heoi3 zo2 jat6 bun2, hai6 mai6?
items.meaning: You actually went to Japan, right?

items.sentence: 我唔去旅行，之所以係因為我冇時間。
items.jyutping: ngo5 m4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, zi1 so2 ji5 hai6 jan1 wai6 ngo5 mou5 si4 gaan3.
items.meaning: The reason why I am not going traveling is because I have no time.

items.sentence: 公司之所以咁快發展，係因為員工合作得好。
items.jyutping: gung1 si1 zi1 so2 ji5 gam3 faai3 faat3 zin2, hai6 jan1 wai6 jyun4 gung1 hap6 zok3 dak1 hou2.
items.meaning: The reason why the company developed so quickly is because the employees worked well together.

items.sentence: 佢之所以成功，係因為佢付出咗好多努力。
items.jyutping: keoi5 zi1 so2 ji5 sing4 gung1, hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 fu6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 nou5 lik6.
items.meaning: The reason why he succeeded is because he put in a lot of effort.

items.sentence: 我哋唔需要擔心，之所以咁講係有充分嘅資料支持。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 seoi1 jiu3 daam1 sam1, zi1 so2 ji5 gam3 gong2 hai6 jau5 cung1 fan4 ge3 zi1 liu2 zi1 ci4.
items.meaning: We don't need to worry; the reason why I say that is because there is sufficient supporting information.

items.sentence: 呢個方案唔錯，你諗下先。
items.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo1ng3 m4 co3, nei5 nam2 haa5 sin1.
items.meaning: This plan isn't bad, think about it first.

items.sentence: 你唔好即刻答我，諗下先啦。
items.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zik1 haak1 daap3 ngo5, nam2 haa5 sin1 laa1.
items.meaning: Don't answer me immediately, think about it first.

items.sentence: 呢件事有啲複雜，你最好諗下。
items.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 di1 fuk1 zaap6, nei5 zeoi3 hou2 nam2 haa5.
items.meaning: This matter is a bit complicated, you better think about it.

items.sentence: 我哋唔好急住決定，諗下所有可能嘅選擇。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 gap1 zyu6 kyut3 ding6, nam2 haa5 so2 jau5 ho2 nang4 ge3 syun2 zaak6.
items.meaning: Let's not rush to decide, think about all the possible options.
